name: Micronaut Core 5.2.16
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Restore the processor options set as system properties after processing by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13780
* Keep the type variable of an Annotated type argument in Python stubs by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13787
* Do not fail a bean definition when one of its @Indexed types is missing by @alvarosanchez in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13794
* Refuse a multipart body that ends before its closing boundary by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13793
* Fix lock-order deadlock between NettyHttpServer and the application context stop by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13715
* Answer with 500 and close the connection when writing the response throws by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13795
* Resolve the target of a qualified proxy-target bean as the proxy's own by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13781
* Run the graceful shutdown before stopping the default Netty server by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13823
* Read standard library members of a Python wrapper in the caller's context by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13830
* Python: track the outputs of generated sources without an origin instead of whitelisting them by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13597
* Apply the qualifier in getBeanRegistrations(Class, Qualifier) by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13726
* Answer body failures read through an InputStream with their status by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13869
### Improvements ⭐
* Ignore Accept-Charset when reading String request bodies by @sharanggupta in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13801
* Compile plain Python helper classes the processor cannot bridge by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13829
* Make Java exceptions Python Exception instances in GraalPy contexts by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13828
* Add missing fetch metadata values by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13839
* Map aware Python datetimes to Instant, OffsetDateTime and ZonedDateTime by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13833
* Inherit connection pool settings for service clients by @liotur in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13906
### Other Changes 💡
* Resolve nested indexed configuration properties for @EachProperty(list = true) by @grimmjo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13697
* Select Callable over Runnable for a Python callable next to further arguments by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13831
* Override methods of a raw generic Java base returning its type variable from Python by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13846
* Python: dispatch inherited varargs methods of a Java base with any number of arguments by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13845
* Make ServerRedirectSpec https redirect test hermetic by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13835
* Allow primitive arrays and arrays of visible classes through host-class-lookup by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13825
* Python: pass the resolution of an inherited type variable parameter to a Java base method by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13872
* Python: leave Java base methods named with $ out of the dispatcher; match a Python class to a Class parameter by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13879
* Pre-start and warm up a pooled Python context after startup by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13834
* Python: construct the Java base before __init__ so inherited calls from the constructor reach it by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13878
* Close the bootstrap context a refresh replaces, and keep the order of the builder properties by @radovanradic in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13956
* Recover the environment from a failed refresh by @radovanradic in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13974

## New Contributors
* @sharanggupta made their first contribution in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13801
* @liotur made their first contribution in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13906

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.15...v5.2.16
